comparison.objective: Candidate tunes a shock absorber and locks its setting; record switches a named wall switch off and installs a lockout cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precise hex-key seating, collar manipulation, counterholding, torque control, and iterative cycling; record requires switch actuation and cover installation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two non-bottoming stops plus setting retention and multiple safety exclusions. Record states OFF-and-locked-out but gives no specs, cover-engagement tolerance, or scoring details.
comparison.reason: Safety lockout of an electrical switch has a different mechanism and outcome from calibrating and retaining a damper setting.
